olivia: Quick follow-up from the rollout metadata RFC thread. I want to lock down: (1) on-path token shape, (2) tenant override precedence, and (3) a tiny runtime safety subset. keeping headers small is highest priority.

sam: proposal: 12-char base62 token in header. layout: 3B ref_hash | 1B cohort | 1B version | 1B flags | 2B checksum (packed). encoder/decoder is tiny. token rotation when doc changes.

maria: telemetry: emit both token and resolved_ref in traces. add `resolution_layer` attribute (anchor|rollout|default) and `schema_ver`. if token rotates, emit event with `old_token->new_token` mapping.

dinesh: runtime constraint: never parse full doc on hot path. runtime accepts token + cohort, consults local resolver. miss => use configured fallback list synchronously; async refresh resolver. keep runtime-visible contract to: token, fallback_order[], deprecation_ts, safety_flags.

kevin: ops: tenant anchors required. precedence: tenant_anchor > rollout_ref > default_ref. anchors must include expires_at and reason. add `grace_seconds` so runtime can allow brief overlap during expiry. also require operator justification in UI.

anjali: SDK UX: expose SDK.onAnchorApplied and SDK.getEffectivePin(tenant). also provide `honor_tenant_anchors: true|false` flag for apps that must opt-out. admin-only.

olivia: sample anchor (off-path) idea: {anchor_id: "anch-3321-01", tenant: "delta-inc", pinned_ref: "model-v3.0", expires_at: "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z", reason: "migration rollback", grace_seconds: 300}. runtime only sees anchor_id + tethered boolean if applicable.

maria: testing: add synthetic scenarios: anchor expiry, anchor renewal rotation, token rotation, and schema_mismatch. QA should have a recorded token replay to validate fallback.

dinesh: probe: runtime will expose `/internal/pin?v=1&tenant=...` returning token, resolved_ref, effective_fallbacks[], applied_anchor_id. rate-limited and auth-protected. helpful for oncall.

kevin: runbook: when token rotates, trigger canary for X% traffic, watch misparse rate and schema-failure metric. include automatic rollback if error_rate > threshold or misparse spikes. encode `safety_policy` in doc: rollback_on_error, error_rate_threshold, min_canary_requests. runtime reads only the small subset.

olivia: Next steps: (1) sam will prototype encoder/decoder and sample token rotation behavior, (2) dinesh will spec resolver caches + probe endpoint, (3) maria will draft telemetry mapping and test cases, (4) kevin will add runbook items and alert thresholds. i'll open a PR with anchor + control-plane schema tomorrow.

sam: will try encoder today, small prototype.

maria: adding tests to QA backlog.

dinesh: will stub probe and outline cache eviction (LRU + pinned entries).

pin-bot: :pushpin: Anchor created: anch-3321-01 for tenant delta-inc, expires 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

kevin: will coordinate canary dashboards with SRE.

olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
